en: You disagree with your parents about a decision that concerns your future.
ph_ar: بابا وماما مش موافقين على القرار اللي اخترته لمستقبلي
ph_en: My parents are against the path I chose for my future

en: You feel that one of your siblings gets more attention than you.
ph_ar: أحس أن أهلي يحبون أخوي أكثر مني
ph_en: I feel my parents favour my brother over me

en: A relative asks you for money and you cannot help.
ph_ar: قريبي طلب مني فلوس وأنا ما عنديش باش نعاونه
ph_en: A cousin asked me for money and I just can't afford it

en: You are caring for one of your parents during an illness.
ph_ar: أنا اللي نخدم على أمي المريضة وتعبت
ph_en: I'm looking after my sick father and I'm worn out

en: You hear hurtful words from someone close to you.
ph_ar: سمعت كلام جرحني من أقرب الناس لي
ph_en: Someone close to me said something really hurtful

en: A quarrel breaks out in the family and you are asked to intervene.
ph_ar: العائلة متخاصمة والكل يبيني أتدخل
ph_en: My family is fighting and everyone wants me to take sides

en: You feel lonely even though you are surrounded by your family.
ph_ar: عايش وسط أهلي وحاسس إني وحيد
ph_en: I feel alone even when I'm with my family

en: You are pushed to attend a family occasion you do not want to go to.
ph_ar: غاصبيني نحضر عرس في العائلة وأنا ما نحبش
ph_en: They're forcing me to go to a family event I don't want to attend

en: Your family rejects the person you want to marry.
ph_ar: أهلي رافضين الشخص اللي بدي أتزوجه
ph_en: My parents refuse the person I want to marry

en: You feel your family does not appreciate your effort.
ph_ar: نتعب على عائلتي وحتى حد ما يقدرني
ph_en: I do so much for my family and nobody appreciates it

en: You discover a family member hid something important from you.
ph_ar: اكتشفت أن أختي خبّت عليّ حاجة مهمة
ph_en: I found out my family kept something important from me

en: You and your siblings disagree about sharing the care of your parents.
ph_ar: أنا وحدي اللي نهتم بالوالدين وخوتي ما يعاونوش
ph_en: My siblings won't share the burden of caring for our parents

en: You are constantly compared with one of your relatives.
ph_ar: دايمًا يقارنوني بولد عمي
ph_en: They always compare me to my cousin

en: You regret raising your voice at your mother or father.
ph_ar: صرخت على أمي وندمان برشا
ph_en: I yelled at my mum and I feel terrible

en: Your parents want you to choose a field of study you do not like.
ph_ar: أهلي يبوني أدرس تخصص ما أحبه
ph_en: My parents want me to study something I hate

en: You are trying to mend a broken relationship with a relative.
ph_ar: بدي أرجّع علاقتي مع خالي بعد قطيعة سنين
ph_en: I want to reconnect with an uncle I haven't spoken to in years

en: A family dispute arises over an inheritance.
ph_ar: المشاكل بدات بيناتنا بسبب الورث
ph_en: My family is fighting over the inheritance

en: You move to live far from your family for the first time.
ph_ar: أول مرة نسكن بعيد على عائلتي
ph_en: It's my first time living away from my family

en: You find yourself responsible for the family after a parent is gone.
ph_ar: بعد ما بابا راح صرت أنا المسؤول على الدار
ph_en: Since my father passed I have to carry the whole family

en: A relative who hurt you apologises, but you are still in pain.
ph_ar: قريبي اعتذر لي بس قلبي لسه موجوع
ph_en: My relative apologised but it still hurts

en: You and your spouse disagree about managing expenses.
ph_ar: أنا ومراتي ديما نتخاصمو على المصروف
ph_en: My wife and I keep fighting about money

en: You feel your spouse does not listen to you.
ph_ar: زوجي ما يسمعني أبدًا
ph_en: My husband never listens to me

en: A conflict arises between your spouse and a member of your family.
ph_ar: مرتي وأمي ما يتفاهموش وأنا في الوسط
ph_en: My wife and my mother can't get along and I'm stuck in the middle

en: Work keeps you so busy that you take less part in married life.
ph_ar: الشغل أخذني من زوجتي وأولادي
ph_en: Work is taking me away from my wife

en: You disagree about how to raise the children.
ph_ar: نختلف أنا وزوجي في تربية الأولاد
ph_en: My husband and I disagree on how to raise the kids

en: You forget an important occasion for your spouse.
ph_ar: نسيت عيد زواجنا وزعلت مني
ph_en: I forgot our anniversary and she is upset

en: You discover that you expected different things from marriage.
ph_ar: اكتشفنا أن كل واحد فينا متوقع حاجة مختلفة من الزواج
ph_en: We realised we expected completely different things from marriage

en: You feel jealous without any clear proof of wrongdoing.
ph_ar: نغير على زوجي برشا رغم أنه ما عمل شي
ph_en: I get jealous of my husband even though he's done nothing

en: You are going through financial hardship that strains your relationship.
ph_ar: الضيقة المادية خربت العلاقة بيني وبين مرتي
ph_en: Money problems are hurting our marriage

en: Your spouse falls ill and your responsibilities grow.
ph_ar: زوجتي مريضة وكل شي صار علي
ph_en: My wife is ill and everything falls on me

en: Your spouse embarrasses you in front of others.
ph_ar: زوجي يحرجني قدام الناس
ph_en: My husband humiliates me in front of people

en: You find it hard to express your emotional needs.
ph_ar: ما نعرفش نقول لزوجي واش نحتاج
ph_en: I can't tell my spouse what I need emotionally

en: You disagree about having children or when.
ph_ar: هو يبي أطفال الحين وأنا مو جاهزة
ph_en: We disagree about when to have children

en: Family members interfere in the private details of your life together.
ph_ar: أهل زوجي يتدخلوا في كل صغيرة وكبيرة
ph_en: My in-laws interfere in everything in our marriage

en: You lose trust after your spouse broke a promise.
ph_ar: وعدني وما وفّاش وما عادش نثق فيه
ph_en: He broke his promise and I can't trust him anymore

en: The relationship is going through a cold, distant phase.
ph_ar: العلاقة بيناتنا بردت وما بقاش كيما قبل
ph_en: Our marriage has gone cold

en: Work forces the two of you to live in different countries.
ph_ar: أنا في بلد وزوجتي في بلد بسبب الشغل
ph_en: My wife and I live in different countries because of work

en: You want to make up after a fight but do not know how to begin.
ph_ar: بدي أصالحها بعد الخناقة بس مش عارف أبدأ
ph_en: I want to make up with my wife after the fight but don't know how

en: You discover you were wrong to accuse your spouse.
ph_ar: اتهمت زوجي ظلم وطلعت غلطانة
ph_en: I accused my husband and it turns out I was wrong

en: You face a possible separation and do not know the next step.
ph_ar: نفكر في الطلاق وما نعرفش شنو نعمل
ph_en: We're thinking about divorce and I don't know what to do

en: Your child refuses to go to school.
ph_ar: ولدي رافض يمشي للمدرسة
ph_en: My son refuses to go to school

en: Your son lies to you out of fear of punishment.
ph_ar: ابني يكذب علي لأنه خايف مني
ph_en: My son lies to me because he's afraid of being punished

en: You discover your child is being bullied.
ph_ar: بنتي يتنمروا عليها في المدرسة
ph_en: My daughter is being bullied at school

en: You notice that your son bullies others.
ph_ar: اكتشفت أن ولدي هو اللي يتنمر على صحابه
ph_en: I found out my son is the one bullying other kids

en: Your child spends a long time in front of screens.
ph_ar: ولدي نهار كامل على التلفون
ph_en: My kid is glued to his phone all day

en: You disagree with your teenage son about his friends.
ph_ar: ما يعجبنيش صحاب ولدي المراهق
ph_en: I don't like the friends my teenage son hangs out with

en: One of your children is jealous of his younger brother.
ph_ar: ولدي الكبير يغار من أخوه الصغير
ph_en: My older child is jealous of the new baby

en: Your son fails an exam despite working hard.
ph_ar: ابني اجتهد ورسب وما عرفت كيف أواسيه
ph_en: My son studied hard and still failed

en: Your child asks a difficult question you cannot answer.
ph_ar: بنتي سألتني سؤال على ربي وما عرفت نجاوبها
ph_en: My daughter asked me a hard question about God and I had no answer

en: You lose your temper with your child and then regret it.
ph_ar: صرخت على ولدي وأنا معصب وندمت
ph_en: I lost my temper with my child and regret it

en: Your child needs extra help with schoolwork.
ph_ar: ولدي ضعيف في القراية ويحتاج دعم
ph_en: My child is struggling at school and needs extra help
